reviews.author: Parisian Nicole
reviews.text: Kyle showed up when he said he would, he talked me through everything that needed to be done, and he gave me a fair flat rate (there were no hidden costs or surprises with the price). He did exactly what he said he would do, and he even fixed the door on our metal fence, which was hard to latch. The job was to replace our damaged D-Box and clean our lines, and he got it done in just a couple of hours. He did an amazing job and is such a nice, respectable guy. He also sent me pictures of the work that was done before closing it up and cleaned the area as well. I highly recommend trying him out instead of one of the bigger companies that want to charge you so much you have to take out a loan for it. Kyle is a very knowledgeable, hard-working young man. Most importantly, he's honest, which I greatly appreciated. I will definitely use him again if I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Nathan Hunt
reviews.text: They were amazing. Great team! They knew exactly what was causing our issues with our septic and immediately went to work. Came the same day and solved the problem. Meticulous with how he wanted the work done, not just a replace and done visit. Showed various parts that would work and recommended what he would use, and even provided a receipt for the part without us even asking. They took a lot of pride in the work they did! They will be ours and our friends/family go to for the future.

reviews.author: Thai Tutt
reviews.text: I called up and described my issue I had with the kitchen sink and he recommended a solution right away. Not 10 minutes later he pulled up and resolved my main drain issue with his hydro jet. Very professional and fair prices. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Leah Stankiewicz
reviews.text: Kyle and his assistant came the same day for sewage backup, which was great. He hydrojetted the line and removed and replaced the toilet wax ring. The toilet is not even, so now it rocks. The hydrojet did not fix the problem, it did work for awhile. Kyle wasn’t as responsive when I tried to contact him the second time. I contacted Roto Rooter who put a camera in the line and located the issue in the front yard close to the city line. He suggested calling the original plumber. Kyle did come back out and put the hydrojet in to the front. There was a large leak. He said we have cast iron pipes without digging it up and said it’ll cost $800 to $1200. I called Roto Rooter back out and he dug it up and saw a utility line had broken our PVC drain pipe. The utility company fixed it.

reviews.author: Melanie Oswalt
reviews.text: Kyle came out multiple times, even willing to come out at night for some plumbing issues. He called me back immediately when I had questions. I would definitely recommend him!!

reviews.author: Gail Black
reviews.text: Was looking someone to fix my sub pump Kyle was able there to bcome same day was able to assess the situation & Solve the problem, clean out the drain and get everything all done in 1 day at a reasonable price and reasonable timeframe. Appreciate all the hard work & the good work attitude.

reviews.text: Kyle was very professional and had our sink unclogged in no time! He also got here a little early! We would recommend his service to everyone!

reviews.text: Our apartment complex had some drain and plumbing issues. Kyle was fair priced, attentive and very knowledgeable. reviews.author: Nicole Dreamsmasher
reviews.text: After multiple quotes I was recommended to Drain Pain. He was out there with in the hour to go over my situation and worked into the night to get water back to my home. He came over the following day and worked for hours digging up my whole yard, replacing piping and fixing the whole mess of a situation that had been caused by wear and tear through out the years. I am so grateful he was able to fix everything for my renters and I in a timely manner. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking to get work done quickly and with out hassle. Since I’m not local I was sent pictures of updates on the work and the communication was as work was being done. Once again I’d highly recommend working with Drain Pain for all your plumbing needs.
